full_page.content:
1947, August 6
The following is a faithful transcription of a carbon copy of a typed note by the Servant of God, Fr. Solanus Casey O.F.M. Cap.
(note added to a letter from Sister Mary C. (Eagen) to Fr. Solanus dated August 6, 1947)
Mount St. Joseph
Aug. 6, 1947
(NOTE) The case herein referred to in the following letter was certainly very remarkable. Mr. Eagen and Wife were brought from Smith's Creek (5 miles So. of Port Huron) January 10, 1925 - had been sent home from Ann Arbor University Hospital fore- going November - given up by doctors as hopeless. He looked like 75 an old man. He was only 39 and looked it when eight days later he drove his own car to report and enroll perpetually. I did not know him till he spoke. Thanks be to the merciful God!
Fr. Sol.
